stemMd: Which finding would most strengthen the author's response to managers who prefer collecting more seeds over keeping records?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Restoration projects using documented samples from several habitats succeed more often than projects using larger undocumented samples from one habitat.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Larger storage rooms can hold more containers.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Most collections use the same color of envelope.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The species name fits on a small label.

explanationMd: The finding directly compares the competing strategies and links documentation plus breadth to the intended outcome. It supports the claim that useful representation can matter more than an undifferentiated count.

distractorRationale.b: Capacity does not show the value of documentation.
distractorRationale.d: Motivation does not compare the proposed strategies.
distractorRationale.e: Label size does not address missing population information.
distractorRationale.c: Packaging color is irrelevant to representativeness.
